title: Nagaland Chief Minister Health Insurance Scheme (CMHIS) Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Nagaland government health insurance programme supporting eligible residents and specified beneficiary categories for hospitalization.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility depends on Nagaland residency and current CMHIS category/enrolment rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Nagaland Chief Minister Health Insurance Scheme (CMHIS).

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
